_doc: Purpose: drafting-standard profile for the JIS (Japan) system, consumed by cadcore.i18n.standards (projection angle plus sheet/line/lettering/title-block conventions). Background: standard-dependent values must live in data rather than code branches, and any field whose standard text was not obtained stays null and is listed in na_fields, so 'not fetched' can never masquerade as a real value; no standard text is reproduced here (R3).

standard_numbers: JIS B 0001 (general principles of mechanical drawing; number as cited by the evidence page, not independently verified against a JSA register)
source.retrieval_method: read-only fetch of public web pages and public PDFs (HTTP status recorded per URL); standard bodies are paywalled and none of their text is copied into this file

projection_angle_evidence.publisher: JSA Webdesk, official JIS preview (Japanese Standards Association)
projection_angle_evidence.http_status: unreachable (connection timeout from this network on the retrieval date)
projection_angle_evidence.shows: Could not be read, so neither the edition nor the projection clause of JIS B 0001 was verified from a standards-body source.

projection_angle_evidence.publisher: IDEA Technology (Japanese engineering firm), JIS drawing-standards article series
projection_angle_evidence.shows: Public secondary article stating that JIS B 0001 practice is third-angle projection and that first-angle is not used in principle in Japan. The server answered HTTP 500 while still serving the article, the publisher is a commercial vendor rather than a standards or academic institution, and the same page is self-contradicting about ISO in another section, so this single low-grade source was judged insufficient to fix a value.
projection_angle_evidence.grade: public secondary source, low-grade (non-200 response, no institutional or academic corroboration reachable)

source.na_policy: null means not fetched (-1), never 'zero'; every null field is listed in na_fields, and no unverified field is given a guessed value.
notes: na_fields lists exactly the null-valued fields, in contract order: a gate can assert set(na_fields) == {k for k, v in profile.items() if v is None}.

The widespread engineering convention that Japan draws in third angle was deliberately NOT entered as a value: the JSA preview and the Japanese academic pages tried on the retrieval date were unreachable (timeout, DNS failure, HTTP 403), so the entry would rest on a single non-institutional source. Reporting NA is the honest state; a JSA-register check is the action needed to fill it.
All numeric tables remain null because JIS bodies are paywalled; no value is copied from the ISO or GB/T profile.
